spec.headline: Business Marketing | Technical & Commercial Storytelling | Campaign Strategy
spec.headline_rationale: This blockchain partner role needs campaign coordination, technical translation and business narratives. Emphasize source-supported technical integrations, B2B coordination, content and research without claiming blockchain or joint ecosystem launch expertise.
spec.summary: Business and digital marketer experienced in connecting technical capabilities with customer priorities and coordinated execution. Directed marketing and e-commerce work across sales, product, finance, IT and operations, and advised clients on goals, targeting and messaging. Developed content across web and email, created digital marketing concepts and evaluated growth opportunities through market research and cost-benefit analysis. Hands-on website and API integration projects add practical technical understanding, while campaign reporting and testing keep recommendations grounded in business performance.
spec.factual_review: Read exact Jobgether Business Marketing Lead blockchain ecosystem job. E060/E076/E078/E114/E109/E063/E001/E066/E079/E095 support facts. No blockchain/DeFi/stablecoin expertise, crypto partnerships, financial-institution launch programs or unsupported case-study portfolio asserted.
spec.tools_rationale: Supported business marketing, analytical and technical tools; no unsupported blockchain platforms or partner-stack claims.
